rationale: 2bi/Digitalni Kiosk is a licensed ME payment institution publishing biller, partnership and wallet expansion news on its own domain.
App Store release notes are a dated, continuously producing feature-change feed for the leading local wallet.
Play listing adds install bands and update cadence for the same wallet; standalone adoption proxy on the dominant ME platform.
Official wallet Facebook page often carries launches first, but platform ToS/scraping terms are unclear and need clearing.
Podgorica digital-banking/payments vendor whose releases and case studies name buying banks; in scope under do_not_narrow.
PSD2/open-banking builder chairing the ICT Cortex fintech committee; blog is an early read on commissioned use cases.
E-fiscalisation/POS vendor site shows how fiscal QR and payment acceptance are bundled to ME merchants.
Local ECR/POS integrator whose solution pages inventory till-level payment integrations; smaller but standalone.
Telco press centre is a dated feed for a non-bank merchant-services challenger bundling POS/invoicing to SMEs.
Service sub-page of postacg.me already covered by the Pošta procurement/parent monitoring; URL check failed, recheck liveness.
Long-running ME tech portal; often the only write-up of small fintech launches and a strong actor-snowball feed.
NTP news stream plus the annual Startup Index is both a recurring publisher and a dated fintech roster.
Accelerator cohort/demo-day announcements are the earliest public trace of pre-product ME fintech teams.
Tracxn is a mine-once fintech roster behind registration/commercial terms; also noisy with foreign-domiciled entities.
BIRN digital-economy platform covering policy friction that shapes wallet/QR scaling; recurring publisher, reuse terms to note.
Investigative outlet surfacing grey-zone e-money/crypto actors; low cadence on-topic but credible and standalone.
Small crypto brokerage with unverified POS-acceptance claims; weak credibility, revisit only if MiCA-aligned ME rules land.
LinkedIn company pages are the fastest ME fintech announcement channel but require login and ToS clearance.
Mandatory national e-procurement portal carrying every ME banking/payment/ATM tender, award and contract.
Procurement policy directorate publishing law, notice forms and annual reports; standalone despite CEJN adjacency.
Appeal decision register naming bidders, specs and prices in contested banking/POS tenders; unique competitive detail.
TED gives CPV-coded, machine-readable EU/IPA notices touching ME financial-sector contracts; bulk open data.
Sole publication point for EBRD client procurement and award notices, ME coverage confirmed.
Single dated EBRD press release; the value is the PSD/news index, not this one artifact — track the parent feed instead.
World Bank ME project list surfaces the TIPS-clone/SEPA operation and its procurement plan — the forward payments pipeline.
Finances One is a structured, downloadable award register giving vendor, amount and method for Bank-financed ME contracts.
Central bank buyer page is high-value for RTGS/TIPS tenders but URL verification failed; recheck liveness before approving.
State post's procurement page is a low-noise feed of counter-terminal, cash-handling and payment-software contracts.
